subject.title: control-ui: expose reply-to metadata to agent sessions and avoid confusing no-output completion notices

question: Should this combined issue stay open as the umbrella, or should maintainers split it between structured Control UI/Gateway reply metadata and the durable final-fallback delivery contract?
rationale: The source evidence shows real remaining work, but the correct owner boundary spans UI request schema, agent runtime metadata, and channel delivery semantics, and an open conflicting PR already covers part of the reply-metadata shape.

options.title: Split Across Existing Work
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90745 or a maintainer replacement for structured reply metadata, keep no-output semantics in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561, and close this issue only after both halves are clearly tracked.

options.title: Keep As Umbrella
options.body: Leave this issue open as the cross-surface coordination tracker until a single maintainer-approved design covers both reply metadata and no-output UX.

options.title: Defer Structured Metadata
options.body: Treat the current Markdown quote behavior as sufficient for Control UI for now and keep only the final-fallback contract active.

recommendation.title: Split Across Existing Work
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90745 or a maintainer replacement for structured reply metadata, keep no-output semantics in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561, and close this issue only after both halves are clearly tracked.

likelyOwner.reason: The current source blame and recent area evidence cover the UI send path, Gateway schema, and runtime-context boundary that need coordination.
